sprint.description: The sprint to build: its number in ephemeral/research/api/SPRINTS.md, e.g. 2.

repo.description: Absolute path of the repository. Each lap is committed to the branch checked out there, and the sprint ends by merging that branch.

model.description: Codex model for the researcher, the planner, and the coders, e.g. "gpt-5.6-luna".

review_model.description: Claude Code model for the supervisors and the validator, e.g. "haiku".

tasks.description: The most tasks to run in all. The sprint fails if the planner is not done by then.
